command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'known_folder_filter_diag.py'; @'

import ctypes as c, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from pywinauto import Desktop

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
profile=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
proc=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(profile)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=os.environ.copy())
win=None
try:
    end=time.monotonic()+20
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        ws=[w for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=proc.pid) if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
        if len(ws)==1:win=ws[0];break
        time.sleep(.25)
    if not win:raise RuntimeError("window missing")
    time.sleep(3)
    filters=[x for x in win.descendants() if x.element_info.automation_id=="LeftNameFilterBox"]
    print("FILTERS",len(filters),flush=True)
    if len(filters)!=1:raise RuntimeError("filter box missing")
    box=filters[0]
    print("FILTER_BEFORE",repr(box.window_text()),"VISIBLE",box.is_visible(),flush=True)
    box.set_edit_text("\ub2e4\uc6b4\ub85c\ub4dc")
    time.sleep(2)
    panes=[x for x in win.descendants() if x.element_info.automation_id=="LeftFiles"]
    rows=[x for x in panes[0].descendants() if x.element_info.control_type=="ListItem"] if panes else []
    print("ROWS_AFTER_FILTER",len(rows),flush=True)
    for x in rows:
        try:
            r=x.rectangle()
            print("ROW",repr(x.element_info.name or x.window_text()),"RECT",(r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height()),"VISIBLE",x.is_visible(),"IMAGES",[(i.element_info.name,(i.rectangle().width(),i.rectangle().height())) for i in x.descendants() if i.element_info.control_type=="Image"],flush=True)
        except Exception as e:print("ROW_ERR",repr(e),flush=True)
finally:
    if proc.poll() is None:
        if win:
            c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(win.handle,0x10,0,0)
            try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.terminate();proc.wait(timeout=5)
        else:proc.terminate();proc.wait(timeout=5)
print("EXIT",proc.returncode,flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $rc
